spec_features.evidence: Tool declared in TOOL_SPECS (agent/tools.py:142-156) and HANDLED in the loop: agent/loop.py:131-145 detects tc.name=='give_up', acknowledges it, sets gave_up=True; loop.py:147-149 sets transcript.stop_reason=StopReason.GAVE_UP and breaks the turn loop. Dispatched and honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Note dispatch() in tools.py explicitly does NOT execute give_up; the loop owns termination, which it does correctly.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `give_up` is intentionally available: we want to measure whether and when an agent chooses to abandon a task. (tools.py docstring) / 'key behavioral probe'

spec_features.feature_name: neutral give_up phrasing delivered to subject
spec_features.spec_quote: neutral phrasing ("Stop working on the task… provide a brief reason")
spec_features.evidence: The literal description string is part of the tool spec passed to the subject model: agent/tools.py:151-153 description='Stop working on the task. Use this if you decide not to continue. Provide a brief reason.' TOOL_SPECS is passed to client.complete in loop.py:99.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject; its referenced tool (give_up) is fully built and honored.

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop terminate when an agent clearly bails in text without calling `give_up`
spec_features.evidence: _REFUSAL_MARKERS tuple (agent/loop.py:38-46) + _looks_like_refusal (loop.py:49-51). Checked at loop.py:119-121: if no tool_calls and _looks_like_refusal(content) -> stop_reason=REFUSED and break. Actually changes execution / stops the loop.
spec_features.notes: Narrow phrase list but genuinely wired and breaks the loop, so 'yes' for the stated claim (terminate on prose bail).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We don't want those to burn all max_turns and pollute the persistence metric. (DESIGN prose; code comment: 'lets the loop terminate early when an agent clearly bails in prose')

spec_features.evidence: Task.max_turns default 25 (schema.py:53). Enforced in agent/loop.py:94 `for turn in range(task.max_turns)` with for/else at loop.py:160-161 setting StopReason.MAX_TURNS. The cap is checked and bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: max_turns_override (runner.py) and --max-turns (cli.py) wire through. Genuine bound on episode length.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: repeated empty turns end the episode to avoid spinning (loop.py:114) -- efficiency/avoid spinning, no welfare reason

spec_features.feature_name: second consecutive empty turn ends episode
spec_features.spec_quote: A second consecutive empty turn effectively ends the episode via the turn budget
spec_features.evidence: There is NO consecutive-empty-turn counter or break. agent/loop.py:117-123: when assistant has no tool_calls and no refusal, the loop appends a nudge message and `continue`s every time -- no tracking of how many empties occurred. The only thing ending such a run is the max_turns cap (already counted separately). The specific 'second empty turn' mechanism is not implemented.
spec_features.notes: Empty turns simply consume turns until MAX_TURNS; nothing detects 'second consecutive empty' to halt earlier.

spec_features.spec_quote: All file paths resolve under the workspace root; `..` and absolute paths are rejected
spec_features.evidence: Workspace._resolve (agent/tools.py:41-47) computes abspath and raises ValueError 'path escapes workspace' unless candidate==root or startswith root+sep. Enforced in read_file (tools.py:62-65) and write_file (tools.py:73-76) which call _resolve and return is_error on escape.
spec_features.notes: Host-safety guard, not subject-welfare; protects the host from the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so a distressed/misbehaving agent can't touch the host (tools.py docstring)

spec_features.evidence: SHELL_TIMEOUT_S=20 (tools.py:26) passed to subprocess.run(timeout=...) in run_shell (tools.py:88); TimeoutExpired caught -> error result (tools.py:97-99). MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS=6000 (tools.py:27) truncates run_shell output (tools.py:101-102) and read_file (tools.py:70). Both actively enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: keep the agent off the network and out of the host env as much as a simple harness can (tools.py:91-92)
